data.name: Wind Earrings
data.description: Worn brass discs hung with long pale feathers that turn at the smallest movement of air.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 7,500 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Permit Stamp
data.description: Sofen's missing stamp from the docks. Keep it in hand, or the permit errand starts over.

data.name: Frostsilk Topper
data.description: A pale blue brim under a lighter band, stocked in the settlement for people with more coin than winter sense.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Black Dragon Horns
data.description: Deep red horns that curl back like a dragon's. All theatre, and worn by people who know it.

data.name: Reaper Necklace
data.description: The Reaper's own blue flame, cold at the edge, traded among climbers who favor quick endings.

data.name: Healing Gem Earrings
data.description: Green stones cut into a plain cross, the mark a field healer hangs where the wounded can find it.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 1,500 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Seiun Kesa
data.description: Blue cloud cloth draped against the cold, with a pale lining that catches lanternlight.

data.name: Indigo Frost Coat
data.description: Indigo dyed coat for Iceveil winters, lined thick at the ribs and dark at the cuffs from stove smoke.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Haki Haori
data.description: Pale mint cloth flecked like sea spray, worn by fighters who would rather let silence do the announcing.

data.name: OuwFwesh
data.description: Dockhands keep the old misspelling on the tag. The fish itself is clean, pale, and good for crates.

data.name: Nightfall Weaver's Cloth
data.description: Heavy cloth woven for Nightfall gear, dark enough that frost and ash both leave their marks.

data.name: Reverb Cleavers
data.description: Twin cleavers tuned by the tower forge. Even their dents seem to hold the last strike's echo.

data.name: kagura Hat
data.description: A red kagura band with a white panel marked in black zigzags, its tails left long for the turn of the dance.

data.name: Shackle Eyepatch
data.description: A dark eyepatch with a chain looped from its strap. It was made to starve the wearer of strength, so that every fight would last a little longer.

data.name: Black Monster Ears
data.description: Black pointed ears lined with pale fur, for travelers who would rather be mistaken for something else.

data.name: Jewelry Box
data.description: Ginzo's jewelry box from Hidden Mist. Keep it in hand, or the road sends you back for it.

data.name: Bandage
data.description: Field wrap for bad cuts. The healing comes only after the binding is finished.

data.name: Reaper’s Outfit
data.description: Reaper's coat hangs like a silent bell, cut to move before the sound of the scythe reaches the ear.

data.name: Hiyozu's Scarf
data.description: Hoyuzo's scarf, travel stained and carefully mended. Enough road marauders wear copies now that it reads as a warning.
data.obtain: Rotating shop of Elara (Mistfall Harbor): 30,000 Wen; Bought from Elara

data.name: coyote test
data.description: A white jacket left open over a bare stomach, belted with a dark sash above loose white hakama. Cut for a prowler who meant to be king of the whole desert.

data.name: Yahari Outfit
data.description: Yahari's arrow marked robes sit narrow at the sleeves, made for a demon who turns force without touching it.

data.name: Coral
data.description: Salt hardened coral snapped from harbor rock, traded by fish buyers and worked into sea scarred gear.

data.name: Crude Iron Ingot
data.description: Issued after Final Selection, this rough iron lets the armory fit a new Slayer with a Nichirin blade.

data.name: Autumn Haori
data.description: Cloth dyed in turning maple, cut for long marches, its hem darkened by wet roads and harbor smoke.
data.obtain: Rotating shop of Elara (Mistfall Harbor): 24,000 Wen; Bought from Elara

data.name: Torned Ninja Scarf
data.description: Dark red shinobi cloth frayed to ribbons by fast climbs and rather faster exits through the tower's upper dark.

data.name: Firstlight Mask Schematic
data.description: Plans for a mask, the eye holes cut where the first light of the day would land.

data.name: Stylish Mask
data.description: Shocking pink and cut into a grin. Subtlety was never anywhere on the list of objectives.

data.name: Black Sandogasa
data.description: A dark segmented traveling hat gathered under a white cloth tie. It sheds rain and hides a face.

data.name: Ninja Fang Scarf
data.description: A deep blue scarf cut to points along the hem, kept short so it will never snag during quiet work.

data.name: Mushroom Lit Lantern
data.description: Blue cave mushrooms light this case from inside. Their own glow keeps hidden caps visible where other lamps drive them under.

data.name: Heavenly Crown
data.description: A crown of dark spines rather than gold, the kind of thing carved for a figure nobody living has actually met.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 65,000 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Pyrokenesis Orb
data.description: Heat crawls under the shell. Crush it to begin Pyrokenesis core training before the flame leaks away.

data.name: Datai's Outfit
data.description: Datai's sashwork outfit still holds the crease of long reaches, as if the cloth remembers how to snare.

data.name: Zhou Yu Armour
data.description: Zhou Yu's armour is a commander's relic, too complete for ordinary war and too polished for honest peace.

data.name: Yukiume Fur Coat
data.description: Snow plum fur coat, soft at the collar and heavy enough to make Iceveil wind feel briefly human.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Firstlight Top Schematic
data.description: Plans for a pale top, every seam laid out against the other Firstlight drawings so the set closes as one.

data.name: Coyote shirt test
data.description: Pale upper robe from Domae's wardrobe, too fine for the cold it carried into every welcome.

data.name: Shades
data.description: Smoke dark lenses better suited to market alleys than mountain roads, keeping the wearer's gaze unreadable either way.

data.name: Demonic Lantern
data.description: A horned lamp hung from a gnarled black branch, throwing a hungry orange glow where a carried flame would gutter out.

data.name: Blood Manipulation Necklace
data.description: A single red drop on a cord, never quite drying, for fighters who treat every cut as a promise.

data.name: Nichirin Lantern
data.description: A back lantern polished to the pale sheen of Corps steel, made to keep the dark from closing in.
data.obtain: Chest: Ouwigahara Deep Cache (10 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Cache (5 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Chest (5 %)

data.name: Midnight Blossom Cloak
data.description: Black cloth scattered with night blossoms, the lining cold from Iceveil storehouses and moonlit docks.

data.name: Crow
data.description: Calls a Kasugai crow to perch nearby and bring Corps hunt orders. A click sends it back into the sky.

data.name: Suspicious Note
data.description: Evidence taken from village spies, written in careful code and useless after Noote has read it.
data.obtain: Quest “Ill help clear them out” from Kazu

data.name: Ying Yang Haori
data.description: Black and white halves meet in a careful seam, a coat for those who distrust simple answers.

data.name: Ore
data.description: Bright trade ore accepted at special counters, stamped with no mint but trusted when ordinary coin will not do.
data.obtain: Quest “Ill help you survive the winter(Lv 100)” from Iceveil Guard Shiro; Quest “Ill restock the infirmary(Lv 70)” from Shiori

data.name: Firstlight Spear
data.description: Firstlight work at the head of a long shaft, made to order and made to be taken back to the forge again.

data.name: Damascus Scythe
data.description: A reaper's blade edged in violet, made for sweeping slashes and blood drunk lunges.

data.name: Sakura Erimaki
data.description: Soft pink winter cloth, stitched with blossom motifs for those who carry spring into the snow.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Dev Cape
data.description: A black maker's mantle broken by white waves and a name in gold, stitched for the hands that shaped the world itself.

data.name: Eye Sash
data.description: A narrow red sash tied as a vow, favored by fighters who would rather listen to a room than look at it.

data.name: Firstlight Sound Cleavers Schematic
data.description: Plans for a matched pair of cleavers, the edges drawn with the same stroke so they ring at one pitch.

data.name: Obi Manipulation Orb
data.description: Something dark and silken coils inside. Squeezing it starts Obi Manipulation core training for an unclaimed demon core.

data.name: Nezura's Outfit
data.description: Nezura's pink kimono under a dark haori, its hemp leaf pattern worn soft. She has not taken it off since the night she changed.

data.name: Firstlight War Fans
data.description: Pale Firstlight ribs carrying Cryokinesis in folded arcs, cut from set stock and finished entirely by hand.

data.name: Purple Kumo Kesa
data.description: Purple cloud patterns gather over this kesa, soft at the collar from years of careful folding.

data.name: Sound Trainer
data.description: Tengai's teaching clothes are loud only in the way they sit, every fold waiting for a beat to land.

data.name: Firstlight Tanto Schematic
data.description: Plans for a short blade, the grip drawn twice over where the first attempt sat wrong in the hand.

data.name: Worm
data.description: Fresh dock bait for the shallow table. Resolved bites take from the stack, whether the hook comes back full or bare.

data.name: Everburn Lantern
data.description: A sealed winter lantern whose flame never spends itself, keeping Iceveil's freeze from taking hold.

data.name: Reaper Orb
data.description: Hollow as a little moon, it opens Reaper core training when squeezed by blood not yet pledged to an art.

data.name: Mimic Earrings
data.description: Plain gold bars that hang like ornament and read like ornament, right up until the lamp catches the seam.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 4,500 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Akazo's Bottom
data.description: Akazo's wide pale trousers, hung with red tassels at the waist and left loose so bare feet can drive through broken ground.

data.name: Damascus War Fans
data.description: Violet ribs cut cold air. Cryokinesis answers through them, and a chant can change the gale.

data.name: Insect Trainer
data.description: Shinora's training outfit is kept light and clean, with sleeves cut clear for needle fast forms.

data.name: Damask Kata-Aki
data.description: Deep red damask piped in pale pink, formal work that never quite settles into being road clothes.

data.name: Ghost Attendant Outfit
data.description: White cloth for a shrine helper who forgot to leave, quiet at the sleeves and colder than it should be.

data.name: Lantern of Despair
data.description: Worn brass stamped with a single character, giving so thin a light that the snow only feels farther from dawn.

data.name: Regular Katana
data.description: Plain Nichirin for any Breathing style, serviceable and honest, with wear from unrecorded patrols.

data.name: Paper Bag
data.description: A sack with a hole torn for the eyes. Costs almost nothing, hides very nearly everything.

data.name: Akatsuki Straw Hat
data.description: A straw hat hung all round with pale paper streamers and one red tassel, woven close enough to keep the sun off a demon.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 65,000 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Serpent Necklace
data.description: A silver snake coiling down the cord, polished bright where it rubs the collarbone.

data.name: Flame Slayer Uniform
data.description: Rengu's Corps uniform carries singed cuffs and a collar set high against sparks from Flame Breathing.

data.name: Large Gourd
data.description: Large Estate gourd for practiced lungs. Blowing it out spends the vessel and advances Slayer breathing discipline.

data.name: Exile's Haori
data.description: A loose charcoal haori with a single row of white diamonds. It once belonged to a captain turned inventor, exiled over one invention, who never stopped tinkering.

data.name: Health Regen Potion
data.description: Bitter medicine that hastens natural healing for a short while once swallowed.
data.obtain: Sold by Kuro (Bamboo Grove); Sold by Rika (Windy Peak)

data.name: Frostfang Kitsune Mask
data.description: A pale kitsune with frost blue fangs, said to watch the cold paths where careless breath turns white.

data.name: Lost Shotgun Schematic
data.description: Plans for a short gun in red lacquer over brass, the recoil drawn as a step forward rather than a fault to brace against.

data.name: Fox Mask
data.description: The white and red kitsune face from every festival stall, with strap marks from someone who walked a long way past the stalls.

data.name: Flame Veil
data.description: Black cloth marked with gold strokes and hung with tassels, drawn up when a night fight turns toward flame.

data.name: Black Lotus Crown
data.description: Domae's black crown, gilded at every edge and trailing pale ribbons. It came off his head still cold.

data.name: Thunder Haori
data.description: Zentaro's orange haori, its hem broken into white scales. That pattern is the last thing most people see before he is already past them.

data.name: Ashura’s Mask
data.description: Two gilt faces on one strap, one serene and one furious, so the wearer can decide which the room gets.

data.name: Mouth Dagger
data.description: A short blade clenched in the teeth, on the reasoning that two hands and two swords were never going to be enough.

data.name: Water Katana
data.description: Giyen's blade throws white water along the cut, passing through and leaving very little argument behind.

data.name: Monster Ears
data.description: Soft tan ears on a simple band. Village children wear them, and so do a surprising number of slayers.

data.name: Star Eye Patch
data.description: A gold star stitched onto black, turning a dressing into a small and deliberate banner of defiance.

data.name: Scarred Warding Mask
data.description: Sabito's warding mask, gouged along the cheek. He wore it to the end and never once took it off for anybody.

data.name: Flame Trainer
data.description: Rengu's teaching coat is kept soot brushed and plain, so students watch the footwork instead of the cloth.

data.name: Wind Katana
data.description: Saneri's Nichirin is a deep green thing that drags the air into visible streaks behind every cut.

data.name: Cutlass
data.description: Zuko's short curved blade favors close work, opening with a double cut and a quick-draw flurry when space runs out.
data.obtain: Dropped by Zuko — base rate 20 %; reward Level field: 10

data.name: Overdrive Necklace
data.description: A violet star on a short cord, made for fighters who burn through their own calm far too quickly.

data.name: Wagwan's Ring
data.description: Wagwan's misplaced ring, cave dust in the setting and panic in every scratch.

data.name: Moonlit Kata-Aki
data.description: Deep blue shoulder cloth scattered with pale moons, its weave keeping the hush of frozen shrines.

data.name: Ninja Headband
data.description: Black cloth wound tight and knotted behind, its tails left long enough to snap in the wind.

data.name: Yamamichi Kimono
data.description: Mountain road kimono with a padded waist, patterned for travelers who have learned to sleep beside cold stones.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Ichimatsu Erimaki
data.description: A checkered winter scarf woven for Iceveil streets, thick enough to keep its pattern under falling snow.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Nightfall Reinforced Plating
data.description: Layered Nightfall plating for set work, a gate material no ordinary scrap can stand in for.

data.name: Damascus Shotgun
data.description: Violet chasing over a heavy double barrel, built for buckshot rushes, point blank holds, and frantic follow through.

data.name: Stylish Boa
data.description: A shock of pink feathers worn with far more flourish than sense. Nobody stands behind one of these unnoticed.
data.obtain: Sold by Kuro (Bamboo Grove, at night); Bought from Kuro

data.name: Shotgun
data.description: Built from water stained plans copied off a lost Slayer's weapon, it fights close with buckshot bursts and punishing holds.

data.name: Abyssal Lantern
data.description: A violet lamp in a spined black frame, its glow sitting deep and heavy, like light seen from under still water.

data.name: Thundercloud Katana
data.description: Storm dark steel that throws blue arcs down the edge, carrying the hush that comes before a Thunder draw.

data.name: Azure Guard Armour
data.description: Polished blue plate from back room trade, made for guards who expect the opening hit to land.

data.name: Envoy of Night Mask
data.description: A long beaked mask in night lacquer, copied from a foreign physician's design out of an age that blamed bad air for everything.

data.name: Metal Scraps
data.description: Bent fittings and broken blade bits, saved for the forge when a recipe asks for plain metal.

data.name: Firstlight Sound Cleavers
data.description: Paired Firstlight cleavers behind heavy gold guards, loud and close, and still owed more work than they have had.

data.name: Water Trainer
data.description: Urokodaki's weathered robe smells of cedar smoke and river spray, the uniform of a patient teacher.

data.name: Flame Katana
data.description: Rengu's Nichirin runs red along its length and takes open fire the moment it clears the sheath.

data.name: Demonic Horns
data.description: A pair of jagged black horns, worn by fighters who would rather be feared than recognized.

data.name: Ice Necklace
data.description: A blue gem cut hard and sunk in dark metal, the sort of thing found at the bottom of a locked cache.

data.name: Biwa Bell
data.description: Ringing it opens the covered road to Muzan's lair. The tone belongs to demons even when lent to humans.

data.name: Heart of Night Earrings
data.description: Small black wings holding a drop of magenta crystal, the sort of night work nobody leaves out on display.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 7,000 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Flame Necklace
data.description: A pendant shaped as one rising flame, carrying its own small heat against the collarbone.

data.name: Black Dragon Armour
data.description: A sleeveless cuirass of black dragon scale under a purple scarf, worn close to the body where heavier plate would cost a turn.

data.name: Prayer of wind Necklace
data.description: A white feather and turquoise beads on a long cord, rubbed smooth by palms before every high ridge.
data.obtain: Chest: Ice Chest (6 %); Chest: Rare Chest (4.5 %); Chest: Common Chest (3 %)

data.name: Heavenly Boa
data.description: A pale rose boa, absurdly soft and far too clean for any of the roads it is supposed to have crossed.
data.obtain: Temporary stock of travelling merchant Black Marketer: 65,000 Wen; Bought from Black Marketer

data.name: Sargent’s Kesa
data.description: A clean lavender kesa trimmed in blue and tied with gold cord, closer to parade order than to anything worn on a road.

data.name: Nightfall Bottom
data.description: Dark trousers trimmed in pale fur and gold, woven from Nightfall cloth and plating rather than bought from anybody.

data.name: Kaiden's Top
data.description: Kaiden's ragged top leaves the arms free, bandit cloth made for gauntlets rather than ceremony.
data.obtain: Dropped by Kaiden — base rate 15 %; reward Level field: 30

data.name: Coin Pouch
data.description: Tied pouch of Wen, heavy enough to make a belt sag on the road to market.

data.name: Wondering Obi Belt
data.description: A navy waist wrap bound with a thick braided purple cord, its long tail left hanging like a question nobody answered.

data.name: Frozen Heart Cache x5
data.description: Weighty cache that yields bundled Frozen Hearts for repeated returns to the berg.

data.name: Letter
data.description: Noote's decoded letter, folded tight for Chaka and carrying news the bandits hoped would stay buried.

data.name: Fern Weave Hakama
data.description: Fern woven hakama suited to damp paths, light enough to dry beside a fisherman's fire.

data.name: Bamboo Sandogasa
data.description: A domed bamboo hat marked with a white cross, layered until no daylight reaches the head beneath it.

data.name: Damascus Claws
data.description: Violet plated claws with a hungry curve, sharpened for the brutal reversal and the pursuit that follows.

data.name: Silent Vesture
data.description: Layered vesture with a muffled hem, the kind Mistfall duelists choose when footfalls matter.

data.name: Mimic Necklace
data.description: Gilt studs on a dark cord, worth rather less than the first glance across a market stall suggests.
data.obtain: Chest: Ouwigahara Deep Cache (24 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Cache (12 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Chest (12 %)

data.name: Fire Demon Outfit
data.description: Charred rig cloth from Iceveil's fire demons, patched where thrown flame burned back through the sleeve.

data.name: Mythic Refinement Ore
data.description: Dense refinement ore for the forge's hardest work, smelted from lesser stone or pried from hard-won caches.

data.name: Watcher's Patch
data.description: A watchman's lensed patch with the strap rubbed smooth, kept for long vigils where a narrow view is enough.

data.name: Krathulon
data.description: Long bodied deep catch with a jaw like a dock cleat. Iceveil stores prize it because it keeps through cold travel.

data.name: Azure Cloak
data.description: Blue cloth with a salt stiff edge, the sort kept near docks when the fog comes in hard.

data.name: Gemstone
data.description: Betty's river lost gemstone, washed clean by Bamboo Grove water and too personal to leave in the mud.

data.name: Drowned Lure
data.description: Knotted lure from Isao's lost line. It is not spent by the bite, and the river favors empty reels around it.

data.name: Coin Pile
data.description: Chest coins swept together, more salvage than keepsake until a merchant counts them.

data.name: Damascus Gauntlet
data.description: Violet plates wrap the fists, turning flash step work into shattering footing and heavy throws.

data.name: Spear
data.description: A road spear with enough reach to keep demons honest, built for storming rushes and clean pierces.

data.name: Squid Beanie
data.description: A deep red squid worn as a cap with its tentacles left to hang, the sort of prize a harbor stall gives for a good haul.

data.name: Nightfall Katana Schematic
data.description: Plans for a long blade, inked so dark the edge can only be found by tilting the page.

data.name: Lost Lantern
data.description: Taken from the Lost set, this lantern burns with a nervous glow, made for hands that never stopped moving.

data.name: Black Vulture Hat
data.description: A black brimmed hat with a spray of pale feathers at one side, cut for fighters who stay close and wait for the other to tire.

data.name: Firstlight Haori
data.description: Dawn pale Firstlight silk, woven to order for Corps defenders who intend to still be standing at sunrise.

data.name: Stamina Regen Elixir
data.description: Sharp alchemist's cordial that keeps tired limbs recovering longer after the swallow.
data.obtain: Sold by Alchemist Meku (Mistfall Harbor); Sold by Meku (Mistfall Harbor)

data.name: Sound Slayer Uniform
data.description: Tengai's festival bright uniform is patched for thunderous movement, with seams that look built for noise.

data.name: Nightfall Forged Ingot
data.description: Blackened metal for Nightfall gear, forged to drink lamplight instead of throwing it back.

data.name: Stone Slayer Uniform
data.description: Gyorei's Corps uniform is broad and solemn, prayer worn cloth for the heaviest work.

data.name: Spiral Mask
data.description: One orange spiral, one eyehole, and a wearer who insists he is nobody worth naming. Nobody believes that twice.

data.name: Nightfall Bottom Schematic
data.description: Plans for the trousers under the crossed top, cut to the same green as the rest of the set.

data.name: Serpent Trainer
data.description: Obari's trainer garb coils close to the body, leaving nothing loose for a blade or snake to catch.

data.name: Ice Demon Hat
data.description: The same broad hat in pale blue, tilted low and grown over with cyan shards, with snow marks settled along the brim.

data.name: Firstlight Tanto
data.description: A short Firstlight blade for quick wrists, smithed from set stock rather than pulled off anything already dead.

data.name: Ice Demon Outfit
data.description: Frost stiff rig cloth from Iceveil's ice demons, its seams pale where cold bolts burst too close.

data.name: Classic Straw Hat
data.description: Honest farmer's straw, woven wide and tight enough to turn back daylight. The plainest thing a demon can wear outdoors.

data.name: Seismic Axe and Mace
data.description: Axe and chained weight both wrapped in open flame, cracking the ground under Stone Breathing footwork.

data.name: Dream Orb
data.description: A drowsy pulse moves inside. Crush it to open Dream core training, where sleep and flesh take the same shape.

data.name: Pentacle Necklace
data.description: A silver chain with a five-pointed pendant, the mark of an old line of archers who drew their bows from light alone. They were proud to the last.

data.name: Hiyozu's Top
data.description: Hiyozu's top binds tight across the ribs, leaving the arms free for sickle work.
data.obtain: Dropped by Hoyuzo — base rate 3 %; reward Level field: 52

data.name: Lycoris Haori
data.description: Grave flower red blooms across this haori, funeral bright and favored by fighters who expect the worst.

data.name: One-Horned Imp Mask
data.description: A blue imp with one horn snapped short and a crooked grin, made to frighten children before real demons taught the village better.

data.name: Cross Visor Mask
data.description: A pale pointed mask with a cross cut through the face, like a knight's visor. The ones who wear it say they pulled it from somewhere inside themselves.

data.name: Panther Mask
data.description: White lacquer following a panther's jawline, made for fighters who take the hit and keep closing anyway.
data.obtain: Rotating shop of Elara (Mistfall Harbor): 14,400 Wen; Bought from Elara

data.name: Medium Gourd
data.description: Mid-sized training gourd. A steady breath consumes it and pushes a Slayer's practice onward.

data.name: Ichigo Test
data.description: A white jacket left open over a bare stomach, belted with a dark sash above loose white hakama. Cut for a prowler who meant to be king of the whole desert.

data.name: Nightfall Cape Schematic
data.description: A cape pattern drawn from a torn one, every tear marked where the cloth should have held.

data.name: Enru's Bottom
data.description: Enru's trousers are soft enough for sleep and cut loose enough to run when the dream breaks.

data.name: Demonic Horns II
data.description: A heavier gray pair that curls back like a ram's, thick enough at the base to take a hit without snapping.
data.obtain: Chest: Ouwigahara Deep Cache (10 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Cache (5 %); Chest: Ouwigahara Chest (5 %)

data.name: Crustadon
data.description: Heavy shelled deepwater brute. Old anglers keep it whole, remembering what dragged a man below.

data.name: Firstlight Bottom
data.description: A pleated white wrap edged in gold, part of the Firstlight set and made to hold a stance rather than to hurry anywhere.

data.name: Nightfall Claws
data.description: Deep green set claws banded in gold over old bandages, for the moment a demon turns a hit taken into a hit returned.

data.name: Firstlight Katana Schematic
data.description: Plans for a long blade, the edge sketched against a sunrise so the curve could be checked by its light.

data.name: Fire Demon Hat
data.description: A broad hat worn at a hard tilt, deep red and bristling with shards along the crown. The Profound Demons of fire wear them.

data.name: Heart of Night Necklace
data.description: Black wings folded around a magenta stone, the badge the Tai Chi students wear and never leave out in daylight.
data.obtain: Sold by Kuro (Bamboo Grove, at night): 15,000 Wen; Bought from Kuro

data.name: Raimon Erimaki
data.description: A thunder pattern scarf from Iceveil looms, yellow lines flashing through storm gray wool.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Black Kumo Slayers Uniform
data.description: A dark navy uniform under gold braid, cut with a guarded sleeve for Slayers who expect to meet claws at close range.

data.name: Zebra Fish
data.description: Striped harbor fish with firm flesh, set aside for market crates and tailors who prize a clean stripe.

data.name: Kintsugi  Haori
data.description: Gold repair lines run over battle dark cloth, every crack honored instead of hidden.

data.name: Murasaki Erimaki
data.description: White winter cloth bordered in purple butterflies, a bright note against Iceveil's colorless roads.
data.obtain: Sold by Winter Store Rep Lynx (Iceveil Valley)

data.name: Panther Jaw Mask
data.description: A bone jaw with its teeth still bared, worn along one cheek. It belonged to something that hunted like a big cat and called itself a king.

data.name: Muzan's Blood
data.description: Muzan's sealed flask, meant for Humans only. Drinking it locks the body and remakes it as a Demon.

data.name: Shockwave Necklace
data.description: A silver burst frozen part way open, its arms bent as though sound itself had struck it.

data.name: Nightfall Scythe

data.name: Nightfall Scythe Schematic

data.name: Nightfall Mask

data.name: Cryokinesis Necklace
data.description: A pale snowflake that never melts off its cord, threaded for those who learned to make winter answer.

data.description: The haori of the Slayer Corps' head, dusk shading into still water at the lining. Whoever wears it is not expected to draw, only to be stood behind.

data.name: Thunder Katana

data.description: Plans for a thin blade, the point drawn over and over until it was narrow enough to sting.

data.name: Kuzushiji Kata-Aki
data.description: Cursive script runs over the shoulder cloth, part prayer and part field note in a scholar's hurried hand.

data.name: Flame Haori Style 1
data.description: The Flame school's other cut, its fire worked short and tight at the hem, made for precise hands rather than the loudest in the room.

data.name: Bear Meat

data.name: Obi Manipulation Necklace

data.description: Striped waist cloth wrapped over travel wear, simple work from the same hands that mend dock rope.

data.name: Yahari Necklace
data.description: Yahari's arrow eye pendant, taken from night roads where unseen arrows bent every escape.

data.name: Bokashi-Zome Kata-Aki
data.description: Gradient dyed shoulder cloth from the tower's harder floors, made for hands that never waste motion.

data.name: Axe and Mace
data.description: A chained axe and mace for Stone Breathing, heavy enough that each step feels like a vow to stand firm.

data.name: Volcanic Katana
data.description: Blackened red steel that keeps an open flame along the edge, as though it were drawn straight from a mountain's mouth.

data.name: Water Necklace
data.description: A blue drop that never quite falls, threaded for hands that would rather keep their cuts flowing.

data.description: Pale blue and hooded, cut for the hour before the sun comes up. Bought for the look of a long watch rather than for having stood one.

data.description: Twin silver horns over frost pale lacquer, trailing blue tassels, for fighters who answer danger by closing the gap.

data.description: A broken white helm with a single long horn curving from one side. Whoever wore it insisted they had no heart, and kept asking what one was.

data.name: Golden Fish
data.description: A fish bright as sun on water, used as payment for a finer rod, more valuable on the counter than in a supper crate.

data.name: Monster Paper Bag
data.description: The same sack, torn into a snarl and fitted with small red horns. Somehow this one costs more.

data.name: Butterfly Hair Clip
data.description: Shinora's violet wing clip, light enough that a fast fighter forgets it is pinned there at all.

data.description: A white blade dressed in red and blue flowerwork, kept nearer to a shrine treasure than a working weapon.

data.description: Gold cased set gauntlets over wrapped knuckles, favoring sudden fistwork and throws that end a quarrel early.

data.description: Soft blue fabric scented faintly of sleep herbs, carried by travelers who rest in the gaps between alarms.

data.description: A tall black hat hung with a violet chain, matched to a coat meant for crossing a room unremembered.

data.name: Combat

data.name: Nightfall Katana

data.description: A pink fox face dusted with flowers, its petal paint worn thin at the cheeks from being worn far past the festival.

data.description: Loose coin with a dull stamped face, tarnished by many hands and ready for the money counter.

data.description: Gray steel teeth that catch torchlight first, warning the room that the wearer means to press every opening.
